subject: CloudHaven vendor portal onboarding — sample evidence capture & presign flow
messages:
From: Alicia Barnes <alicia@cloudhaven.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudhaven.com
Date: 2028-03-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CloudHaven portal onboarding — minimal sample capture question

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Our security team reviewed the onboarding checklist and had a couple of practical questions about the evidence sample you ask for during Whistic/Vendr imports:

1) For SOC 2 sections where you request a "sample control artifact", can Redwood accept presigned S3 links (with TTL) for a rolling 72-hour window, or do you require direct upload into your portal?
2) We have a draft CAIQ and a PDF snapshot of our SOC 2 report; should we upload both, or do you prefer a compact claim set for initial ingestion?
3) Can you share a short template of the minimal filenames/metadata you need so our ops team can name artifacts correctly?

Attaching our CAIQ draft for context (cloudhaven_caiq_draft.pdf). We can provide a presign manifest if that is the easier path.

Proposed next step: a 30-min working session tomorrow to confirm the flow (here's a scheduling link: https://cal.com/cloudhaven/30).

Appreciate it — Alicia

--
Alicia Barnes
Head of Security & Privacy
CloudHaven Analytics
A: alicia@cloudhaven.com
From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-27T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudHaven portal onboarding — minimal sample capture question

Alicia — thanks, and great questions. Looping in Mina (security intake) and Olga (evidence ops) to confirm specifics.

Short answers:
- We can accept presigned S3 links for initial ingestion, prefer TTL 24–72 hours depending on sensitivity (72h fine for most snapshots).
- Start with the compact CAIQ + one SOC 2 control artifact per control family (sampled). We do ingest full PDFs later if needed for auditors.
- See attached presign policy and a tiny naming template (s3-presign-template.csv) to make manifest ingestion deterministic.

Mina / Olga: can you confirm the minimal metadata fields we need (control id, evidence_date, uploader, checksum) and whether we should ask CloudHaven to include a short JSON manifest alongside presigned objects or just a CSV?

If convenient, let's join Alicia on the 30-min call tomorrow to walk the manifest step.

Thanks — Markus

--
Markus Klein
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Barnes <alicia@cloudhaven.com>
Date: 2028-03-27T13:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudHaven portal onboarding — minimal sample capture question

FW: Alicia's note and Markus' ask — internal checklist / proposed manifest format below.

Mina's minimal evidence checklist (for intake team to validate presigned ingestion):
- Required metadata per artifact: vendor_control_id, control_family, evidence_date (YYYY-MM-DD), uploader_name, uploader_email, sha256_checksum, evidence_type (pdf/screenshot/log), sensitivity_tag (public/internal/secret).
- Acceptable delivery: CSV manifest + presigned S3 URLs OR single JSON manifest that lists objects and metadata. CSV is easier for procurement teams; JSON preferred if there are nested fields.
- Presign TTL: default 72 hours. For credentials/proof-of-possession artifacts with live tokens choose 24h.
- Filename convention we recommend: <vendor>_<controlID>_<YYYYMMDD>_<short-desc>.<ext> (we included an example CSV in s3-presign-template.csv).
- Sampling policy: for initial onboarding accept 1 artifact per control family + 1 SOC2 summary PDF. We will request additional artifacts only if a sample fails automated parsing or if an auditor asks.

Operational notes for evidence ops (Olga):
- We will run an automated checksum validation on ingestion; please confirm whether you want the raw CAIQ PDF persisted to the portal or only a hashed index entry.
- I'll prepare a short internal runbook that maps CAIQ sections -> Redwood control IDs and share by EOD.

Attachments included for CloudHaven: presign_policy.md, s3-presign-template.csv

Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Security Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Barnes <alicia@cloudhaven.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudHaven portal onboarding — minimal sample capture question

Thanks, all — that's exactly the level of detail we needed. We'll assemble the CSV manifest following your filename convention and include sha256 checksums.

Quick notes:
- We'll set default presign TTL to 72 hours for the CAIQ and report snapshots; 24 hours for any live-token artifacts.
- We'll upload the compact CAIQ and one control artifact per family as the initial batch. If ingestion checks out, procurement will forward the larger PDFs in a secondary bundle.

I've scheduled the 30-min working session for tomorrow at 10:00am PT and added a Drive folder with preliminary artifacts (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_evidence_folder). Please confirm if that time works for you.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alicia

--
Alicia Barnes
Head of Security & Privacy
CloudHaven Analytics

Notes: Attachments referenced in-thread: cloudhaven_caiq_draft.pdf (from CloudHaven), presign_policy.md (from Redwood), s3-presign-template.csv (from Redwood).
